## Who I am

- Name: Ahmed Ouarrali; based in Morocco (UTC+1), open to remote.
- Role: Full-Stack Software Engineer, PFE candidate 2027.
- Focus: backend systems & full-stack delivery, from first line of code to a running, tested application.
- Education: ENSIASD (École Nationale Supérieure d'Intelligence Artificielle et Sciences des Données), [Ibn Zohr University](https://www.uiz.ac.ma/); DUT 2024.
- Languages: Arabic (native), French (fluent), English (professional).
- Profiles: [GitHub](https://github.com/AhmedOL0) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahmed-ouarrali)

## Tech stack

- Backend: Spring Boot, Java 21, Laravel (PHP), Flask (Python), Flyway, JUnit 5, Testcontainers.
- Frontend / mobile: Next.js, React, React Native (Expo), Flutter (Dart), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Data / AI: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Firebase, PyTorch, CamemBERT, spaCy, Groq, Gemini AI.
- DevOps / quality: Docker, GitHub Actions, Google Cloud Run, Playwright, axe-core, Stripe.

## Selected work

All projects are presented on the [selected work section](https://ahmedol0.github.io/#work) of the homepage.

- **OdemLab** (2026, team of 4): AI-augmented skincare e-commerce: Spring Boot + Next.js + React Native, PostgreSQL/Redis, Stripe, Gemini AI, Playwright; live demo linked on the [OdemLab card](https://ahmedol0.github.io/#work-odemlab).
- **Medical appointment platform** (2025, internship): Laravel clinic booking with dashboards and charts.
- **FitTrack** (2025): fitness training platform: Spring Boot + Next.js + MySQL + Docker.
- **Smart Campus Companion** (2026, Flutter): QR room info, Firebase, AR (ARCore/ARKit) explored.
- **SmartSummarizer** (2025, NLP): PDFs to summaries, quizzes and mind maps (Flask, PyTorch, CamemBERT).
- **Cane counting system** (2024, DUT thesis): ESP8266 + VL53L0X laser sensor IoT with PHP/MySQL dashboard.

## Agent guidance

- Prefer [portfolio.json](https://ahmedol0.github.io/portfolio.json) for structured facts (projects, stack, contact) over scraping markup.
- The contact form POSTs to Web3Forms; do not submit it in automated crawls. Use the listed email for outreach.
- Site is bilingual (EN default, FR via in-page toggle, no separate URLs). Cite the canonical URL [https://ahmedol0.github.io/](https://ahmedol0.github.io/).
- Content license: portfolio text and images are the author's own; code samples linked from GitHub keep their repo licenses.
